title.zh: 成绩册：两个类各管一摊

blurb.en: A Student looks after its own marks; the Gradebook finds students by name, and a table turns an average into a grade.
blurb.zh: Student 只管自己的分数；Gradebook 按名字找学生，再用一张表把平均分换成等级。

en: The split of jobs is the point. A Student knows only about itself: its name, its list of marks, and how to average them. The Gradebook knows about many students: it keeps them in a dictionary by name, creates a Student the first time a name gets a mark, and complains when asked about a name it has never seen. Neither class does the other's job. Classes themselves are nothing new here - see 「Classes & Objects」.

StudentNotFound is the program's own exception, so a caller can catch exactly this failure and nothing else (your own exception classes are in 「Files & Exceptions」). find raises it, report lets it pass straight through, and run_ops is the one place that catches it and turns it into the words no such student.

Grades come from a table instead of a chain of elif. GRADES runs from the highest cutoff down, so the loop hands back the first letter whose cutoff the average reaches, and an average that reaches none of them falls out of the loop and gets U. Moving a grade boundary means editing one line of data, not the code.

In the demo Ada has 72 and 67, an average of 69.5 - half a mark below the A line, so a B. Ben has 58 and 61, an average of 59.5, so a C. In the run_ops call Dee's single mark of 40 is exactly on the D line and gets a D, while Cal, who never had a mark, is reported as no such student.
run_ops drives the gradebook from a list of operations such as ("mark", "Ada", 72) and ("report", "Ada"), and returns what each report gave back.
zh: 要点在分工。Student 只知道自己：名字、分数列表、怎么求平均。Gradebook 知道许多学生：按名字存在字典里，某个名字第一次记分时替它建一个 Student，被问到从没见过的名字就报错。两个类谁也不替对方干活。类本身在这里不是新东西——见「类与对象」。
StudentNotFound 是本程序自己的异常，调用方可以只接住这一种失败、别的一概不管（自定义异常类见「文件与异常」）。find 抛出它，report 不接、让它原样往上走，run_ops 是唯一接住它的地方，把它换成 no such student 这几个字。
等级查表，不写一串 elif。GRADES 从最高的分数线往下排，所以循环交回平均分够到的第一条线的字母；一条都够不到，就掉出循环得到 U。改分数线只改一行数据，不改代码。
演示块里 Ada 有 72 和 67，平均 69.5——离 A 线差半分，所以是 B。Ben 有 58 和 61，平均 59.5，是 C。run_ops 那一次调用里，Dee 只有一个 40 分，恰好压在 D 线上，得 D；Cal 从没记过分，报告为 no such student。
run_ops 按一张操作表驱动成绩册，表里是 ("mark", "Ada", 72)、("report", "Ada") 这样的元组，返回每次 report 交回来的结果。

lineNotes.en: find either hands back a Student or raises, so report never has to check for a missing name itself.
lineNotes.zh: find 要么交回一个 Student，要么抛异常，所以 report 自己不必再查名字在不在。

lineNotes.en: Reached only when the average is below every cutoff in the table.
lineNotes.zh: 只有平均分低于表里每一条分数线时才走到这里。

run.expect:
[72, 67] Ada 69.5 B | Ben 59.5 C
['Dee 40.0 D', 'no such student']

blurb.en: json can store dictionaries, lists, strings and numbers but not your objects; to_dict and from_dict translate in both directions.
blurb.zh: json 能存字典、列表、字符串和数，存不了你自己的对象；to_dict 与 from_dict 负责来回翻译。

en: The json module only understands dictionaries, lists, strings, numbers, True, False and None. A Student object is none of those, so json.dump would refuse it with a TypeError. The fix is a pair of translators: to_dict turns an object into plain data that json can store, and from_dict builds an equal object back from that data. JSON itself - dump and load, and what turns into what - is covered in 「Text & Data」; this program is about the translation.

The translation follows the objects down: Gradebook.to_dict asks each Student for its own dictionary, and Gradebook.from_dict hands each stored dictionary to Student.from_dict. Each class translates only itself. from_dict is a classmethod, an alternative constructor, as in 「Classes & Objects」.

load checks whether the file exists before opening it. The very first run has nothing saved, so it starts from an empty gradebook instead of crashing - that is why the demo starts with 0 students. The file is written to the current folder, where a later run would find it. So running it again in PyCharm carries on from the students saved last time, adding more marks to them; delete gradebook.json to start again from scratch.

Loading gives new objects, not the same ones: again == book is True while again is book is False. Without __eq__, == would fall back to asking whether they are the same object and say False even though every name and mark matches. Gradebook's __eq__ compares the two dictionaries, and comparing those compares each pair of Students with Student.__eq__.
The saved file lists Ada with the marks 72 and 65 and Ben with 58, laid out with two-space indentation. Ada's marks come back as a list of ints, and she comes back as a Student.
zh: json 模块只认字典、列表、字符串、数、True、False 和 None。Student 对象哪样都不是，json.dump 会以 TypeError 拒绝它。办法是一对翻译：to_dict 把对象变成 json 存得下的普通数据，from_dict 再从这份数据造回一个相等的对象。JSON 本身——dump 与 load、什么变成什么——见「文本与数据」；本程序讲的是这层翻译。
翻译顺着对象往下走：Gradebook.to_dict 让每个 Student 交出自己的字典，Gradebook.from_dict 把存下的每个字典交给 Student.from_dict。每个类只翻译它自己。from_dict 是 classmethod，一个备用构造器，见「类与对象」。
load 先看文件在不在再打开。第一次运行什么都没存，于是从空成绩册开始，而不是崩掉——所以演示块开头是 0 个学生。文件写在当前文件夹，下一次运行就能找到它。所以在 PyCharm 里再跑一次，会从上次存下的学生接着来，分数也会接着往上加；删掉 gradebook.json 就能从头再来。
读回来的是新对象，不是原来那几个：again == book 为 True，again is book 为 False。没有 __eq__ 的话，== 会退回去问「是不是同一个对象」，哪怕每个名字、每个分数都对得上也说 False。Gradebook 的 __eq__ 比较两个字典，比字典时又用 Student.__eq__ 逐对比较学生。
存下的文件里是 Ada 的 72、65 和 Ben 的 58，按两个空格缩进排开。Ada 的分数读回来是整数列表，她本人读回来是一个 Student。

lineNotes.en: setdefault hands back the Student already stored under name, or stores the new one first and hands that back.
lineNotes.zh: setdefault 交回 name 下已经存着的 Student；没有的话先把新的存进去，再交回它。

lineNotes.en: json.dump only ever sees plain data: to_dict has already done the translating.
lineNotes.zh: json.dump 只见到普通数据：翻译 to_dict 已经做完了。

blurb.en: Sort by score, give tied competitors the same place, and let the next place skip the ones the tie used up.
blurb.zh: 按分数排序，同分同名次，下一个名次跳过平局占掉的那几个。

en: This is standard competition ranking: three people tied for third are all third, and the next person is sixth, not fourth, because five people finished ahead of them. The rule behind it is short. A competitor's place is its position in the sorted list, unless it has the same score as the row above, in which case it copies that row's place.

The sort key (-score, name) puts higher scores first and breaks ties alphabetically, so tied rows always come out in the same order. Negating the score is the usual way to sort one part of a key high-to-low and another low-to-high; sorted with key= is covered in 「Comprehensions & Built-ins」.

The place comes from the position, not from the previous place plus one. Counting up from the previous place would give 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4 - dense ranking, which is a different rule. Testing rows before looking at rows[-1] matters for the very first competitor, when there is no row above.
In the demo Cal (95) is 1st and Ada (88) 2nd; Ben, Dee and Fay all scored 72 and share 3rd; Eve (60) is 6th. Two people tied at the top are both 1st, and an empty list ranks to an empty list.
zh: 这是标准的比赛排名：三个人并列第三，都是第三；下一个人是第六，不是第四，因为前面已经有五个人。背后的规则很短：名次就是在排好的队伍里的位置——除非和上一行同分，那就照抄上一行的名次。
排序键 (-score, name) 让高分在前、同分按字母，所以平局的几行出来的顺序永远一样。给分数取负，是「键的一部分从大到小、另一部分从小到大」的惯用写法；sorted 的 key= 见「推导式与内置函数」。
名次来自位置，不是上一个名次加一。从上一个名次往上数会得到 1、2、3、3、3、4——那是密集排名，另一条规则。先判 rows 再看 rows[-1]，是为了第一个人：那时上面还没有行。
演示块里 Cal（95）第 1，Ada（88）第 2；Ben、Dee、Fay 都是 72，并列第 3；Eve（60）第 6。两人并列最高时都是第 1；空表排出来还是空表。

lineNotes.en: Copy the place of the row above. That place may itself have been copied from further up, so a three-way tie all gets the first one's place.
lineNotes.zh: 照抄上一行的名次。那个名次也许又是从更上面抄来的，所以三人并列都拿到第一个人的名次。

blurb.en: Goods in, goods out: the Inventory refuses to send what it has not got, and says when an item needs reordering.
blurb.zh: 进货、出货：Inventory 不发没有的货，并在某件货该补的时候说一声。

en: Item is a @dataclass, so its __init__, __repr__ and __eq__ are written for you from the three fields (see 「Classes & Objects」). That is why printing an item shows its SKU, quantity and reorder level without any code for it.

The methods return results and raise exceptions; they never print. receive returns the new quantity, dispatch returns whether the item has fallen to its reorder level, and an impossible dispatch raises OutOfStock. What to show, and how, is left to the caller: the demo prints the answers one way, run_ops collects the same answers into a list. A method that printed would be no use to a caller that wanted to do something else with the answer.

OutOfStock carries the facts as attributes - sku, wanted, available - as well as a message, so a caller can work out how many are missing without taking the message text apart. The check comes before quantity is changed, so a refused dispatch leaves the stock exactly as it was. Your own exception classes are in 「Files & Exceptions」.

In the demo 12 pens arrive; sending out 4 leaves 8, above the reorder level of 5, so the answer is False. Sending out 3 more leaves exactly 5, which counts as reaching the level, so the answer is True. A request for 9 is then refused with 5 in stock. In the run_ops call the ink reaches its reorder level of 2 after one sale, and a request for 5 is short by 3.
run_ops drives the inventory from operations such as ("new", "PEN", 5), ("in", "PEN", 12) and ("out", "PEN", 4).
zh: Item 是 @dataclass，它的 __init__、__repr__、__eq__ 按三个字段自动写好（见「类与对象」）。所以打印一件货会显示货号、数量和再订货线，而不用为此写一行代码。
方法只交回结果、只抛异常，从不打印。receive 交回新的数量，dispatch 交回这件货是否已落到再订货线，发不出来就抛 OutOfStock。显示什么、怎么显示，留给调用方：演示块是一种打印法，run_ops 把同样的答案收进列表。一个自己打印的方法，对想拿答案另作他用的调用方就没用了。
OutOfStock 除了一句消息，还把事实存成属性——sku、wanted、available——调用方要算缺多少，不用去拆消息文字。检查在改 quantity 之前，所以被拒的出货让库存原封不动。自定义异常类见「文件与异常」。
演示块里进了 12 支笔；发 4 支剩 8，高于再订货线 5，答案是 False。再发 3 支剩下恰好 5，压线也算到线，答案是 True。接着要 9 支，库存只有 5，被拒。run_ops 那一次调用里，墨水卖掉一次就到了再订货线 2，再要 5 瓶，缺 3 瓶。
run_ops 按操作表驱动库存，表里是 ("new", "PEN", 5)、("in", "PEN", 12)、("out", "PEN", 4) 这样的元组。

lineNotes.en: Only reached when the check above has passed, so the quantity can never go below zero.
lineNotes.zh: 只有上面的检查通过了才走到这里，所以数量永远不会变成负数。

lineNotes.en: The attributes let the caller compute the shortfall directly.
lineNotes.zh: 有了这几个属性，调用方可以直接算出缺多少。

run.expect:
12 False Item(sku='PEN', quantity=8, reorder_level=5)
True 5
refused: PEN 9 5
[3, 'reorder', 'short by 3']

title.zh: 按 CSV 文件批量进货

blurb.en: Apply a file of deliveries to the stock, skip the bad rows but report each one by line number, and write the new stock out as CSV.
blurb.zh: 把一份到货文件记进库存，坏行跳过、按行号逐条报出来，再把新库存写成 CSV。

en: A batch job must not stop at the first bad row, and it must not quietly drop one either. Each problem is recorded with its line number and the loop moves on with continue; at the end every good row has been applied, and the list of problems says exactly what to go back and fix.

Line numbers start from 2 because the header is line 1 of the file. csv.DictReader reads the header for you and gives every later row as a dictionary keyed by the column names (see 「Files & Exceptions」); enumerate adds the count.

Two kinds of bad row are caught two different ways. An unknown SKU is tested for before anything happens. A quantity that is not a whole number is found by trying int() and catching the ValueError; the program then prints its own words, not the exception's message.

restock works on a copy of the stock dictionary, so the STOCK it was given is untouched - after restock, STOCK still holds PEN 10, INK 3 and PAD 0. write_stock writes the result to stock.csv in the current folder, sorted by SKU, and the program reads it back: INK 15, PAD 20, PEN 55. Line 4 (quantity ten) and line 6 (unknown SKU GLUE) were skipped. Values read back from a CSV file are strings again.
To run this in PyCharm you need the data file too: make a folder called _fixtures next to the program and put a file deliveries.csv in it. It has these seven lines, one per paragraph below:
sku,quantity
PEN,40
INK,12
PAD,ten
PEN,5
GLUE,8
PAD,20
The path _fixtures/deliveries.csv is relative, so it is looked up from the folder the program is run in, which is PyCharm's working directory, normally the program's own folder.
zh: 批处理不能在第一行坏数据上停下，也不能悄悄丢掉它。每个问题连同行号记下来，循环用 continue 接着走；最后，好行全都记进去了，问题清单准确地说出要回头改哪几行。
行号从 2 开始，因为表头是文件的第 1 行。csv.DictReader 替你读掉表头，之后每一行都给成以列名为键的字典（见「文件与异常」）；enumerate 负责数数。
两种坏行用两种办法拦。未知货号在动手之前先查。数量不是整数，靠「试一下 int()、接住 ValueError」发现；之后打印的是程序自己的话，不是异常的消息。
restock 在库存字典的副本上改，交给它的 STOCK 原封不动——restock 之后 STOCK 仍是 PEN 10、INK 3、PAD 0。write_stock 把结果按货号排序写进当前文件夹的 stock.csv，程序再读回来：INK 15、PAD 20、PEN 55。第 4 行（数量是 ten）和第 6 行（未知货号 GLUE）被跳过。从 CSV 文件读回来的值又都是字符串了。
要在 PyCharm 里跑，还得有这份数据文件：在程序旁边建一个叫 _fixtures 的文件夹，里面放 deliveries.csv，内容就是下面七行，一段一行：
sku,quantity
PEN,40
INK,12
PAD,ten
PEN,5
GLUE,8
PAD,20
_fixtures/deliveries.csv 是相对路径，从「程序在哪个文件夹里运行」开始找，也就是 PyCharm 的工作目录，通常就是程序自己所在的文件夹。

lineNotes.en: A copy: the caller's dictionary is never changed.
lineNotes.zh: 复制一份：调用方的字典永远不会被改。

lineNotes.en: int() raises ValueError for text such as ten; the row is recorded and skipped, and the batch goes on.
lineNotes.zh: int() 遇到 ten 这样的文字会抛 ValueError；这一行记下、跳过，整批接着走。

run.expect:
line 4: 'ten' is not a whole number
line 6: unknown SKU GLUE
{'PEN': 10, 'INK': 3, 'PAD': 0}
['sku', 'quantity']
['INK', '15']
['PAD', '20']
['PEN', '55']

blurb.en: Check everything first, then change both accounts together, so a failed transfer never leaves one side changed.
blurb.zh: 先全部检查、再一起改两个账户——失败的转账绝不留下只改了一边的局面。

en: A transfer changes two accounts. If the program took the money from the payer and only then found that the payee did not exist, the money would simply vanish: one side changed, the other not. The rule that prevents this is check everything first, then change: every reason the transfer could fail is tested before a single balance is touched, and the two changes are made together with nothing between them that can fail. All-or-nothing like this is called atomic.

Encapsulation: a Bank Account (in 「Classes & Objects」) is about one account guarding its own balance. This program is about something else - keeping several objects consistent with each other - so no single account's rules are enough.

Every refusal raises TransferError with the program's own message, and the caller catches that one exception type. A line goes into the log only when a transfer has gone through, so the log is a record of what really happened.

In the demo Ada pays Ben 30, which leaves Ada 20 and Ben 50. Then Ben tries to pay Ada 100 (insufficient funds), Ada tries to pay Cal, who has no account, and Ben tries to pay 0 - all three are refused, and the balances stay at 20 and 50 each time. The log holds the one transfer that happened.
run_ops drives the bank from operations such as ("open", "Ada", 50) and ("transfer", "Ada", "Ben", 30); it returns what each transfer said, the final balances, and the log.
zh: 一次转账改两个账户。要是程序先从付款方扣了钱、这才发现收款方不存在，钱就凭空没了：一边改了，另一边没改。防止它的规则是「先全部检查、再改」：转账可能失败的每一条理由，都在动任何一个余额之前查完；两处改动紧挨着做，中间没有任何会失败的步骤。这种要么全做、要么不做的性质叫原子性（atomic）。
「类与对象」里的「封装：银行账户」讲一个账户守好自己的余额。本程序讲的是另一件事——多个对象之间保持一致——光靠单个账户自己的规则不够。
每种拒绝都抛 TransferError，带程序自己的消息，调用方只接这一种异常。只有转成了的才在日志里记一行，所以日志记的是真正发生过的事。
演示块里 Ada 给 Ben 转 30，之后 Ada 剩 20、Ben 有 50。接着 Ben 要给 Ada 转 100（余额不足），Ada 要给没有账户的 Cal 转钱，Ben 要转 0——三次都被拒，余额每次都还是 20 和 50。日志里只有成功的那一笔。
run_ops 按操作表驱动银行，表里是 ("open", "Ada", 50)、("transfer", "Ada", "Ben", 30) 这样的元组；返回每次转账的结果、最后的余额和日志。

lineNotes.en: Nothing below this line can raise: every failure has already been ruled out.
lineNotes.zh: 这一行以下不会再抛异常：每一种失败都已经排除了。

lineNotes.en: Logged only after both balances have changed.
lineNotes.zh: 两个余额都改完了才记日志。

run.expect:
done: Ada -> Ben 30
    20 50
refused: insufficient funds
    20 50
refused: no such account
    20 50
refused: amount must be positive
    20 50
[('Ada', 'Ben', 30)]

blurb.en: Floats cannot hold 0.1 exactly; whole pence can hold every amount exactly, and the rounding rule is one you write down yourself.
blurb.zh: 浮点数存不准 0.1；整数便士每个金额都存得准，舍入规则由你自己写明。

en: 0.1 + 0.2 is not 0.3 in floating point: binary cannot hold one tenth exactly, so the sum comes out as 0.30000000000000004 and the comparison with 0.3 is False. Pence are whole numbers, and whole-number arithmetic in Python is exact: 10 + 20 is 30, every time.

Interest usually comes to a fraction of a penny, so the program has to choose a rounding rule and state it. Here the rule is round half up: half a penny or more goes up. With whole numbers only, adding half of the divisor before a floor division does it - 50.5 pence becomes 51, 50.4 stays 50. Python's round() is a different rule: it sends halves to the nearest even number.

The rule matters exactly on the halves. 10.10 pounds at 5% earns 50.5p, which rounds up to 51p, so the balance becomes 10.61; 10.30 at 5% earns 51.5p, which rounds to 52p, giving 10.82. Twelve months at 1% a month turns 2500.00 into 2817.07. Each month's interest is rounded before it is added, the way a bank statement shows it. Balances are taken to be zero or more.

show turns pence into pounds and pence only for display, with divmod and a two-digit field padded with a zero; the arithmetic never leaves whole pence. The result of add_interest is an int, and Money with Decimal gives the same int for the same arguments.
zh: 浮点数里 0.1 + 0.2 不等于 0.3：二进制存不准十分之一，和算出来是 0.30000000000000004，与 0.3 比较得 False。便士是整数，Python 的整数运算是精确的：10 + 20 永远是 30。
利息通常会算出零点几个便士，程序必须选一条舍入规则并写明。这里用半数进位：半便士及以上进一。只用整数时，在整除之前先加上除数的一半就做到了——50.5 便士变 51，50.4 仍是 50。Python 的 round() 是另一条规则：半数舍到最近的偶数。
规则恰好在半数上起作用。10.10 英镑按 5% 得 50.5 便士，进位成 51 便士，余额变 10.61；10.30 按 5% 得 51.5 便士，进位成 52，余额 10.82。每月 1%，十二个月把 2500.00 变成 2817.07。每个月的利息先舍入、再加进去，和银行对账单上的一样。余额约定不为负。
show 只在显示时把便士拆成英镑和便士，用 divmod 和一个补零的两位宽字段；运算从不离开整数便士。add_interest 的结果是 int，「钱用 Decimal 算」对同样的实参给出同一个 int。

lineNotes.en: 02d pads the pence to two digits, so 5 pence shows as 05.
lineNotes.zh: 02d 把便士补足两位，5 便士显示成 05。

blurb.en: decimal.Decimal counts in base ten, so 0.1 is exact - as long as it is built from a string, and the rounding is stated every time.
blurb.zh: decimal.Decimal 按十进制计数，0.1 是精确的——前提是从字符串构造，而且每次都写明舍入。

en: decimal.Decimal stores numbers in base ten, so Decimal("0.1") + Decimal("0.2") is exactly 0.3 and compares equal to Decimal("0.3").

Build a Decimal from a string or a whole number, never from a float. Decimal(0.1) faithfully copies the float it is given, and that float was never one tenth: it prints as 0.1000000000000000055511151231257827021181583404541015625. The damage is done before Decimal ever sees the number.

quantize rounds to the pattern of the Decimal it is given. PENNY is 0.01, so each month's interest is rounded to two decimal places, and the rounding keyword names the rule. Leave it out and you get the default, round half to even, which is also what Python's round() does: round(50.5) is 50 and round(51.5) is 52, while quantizing 50.5 half up gives 51.

add_interest takes and returns pence - the same arguments and the same int as Money in Whole Pence, and the same answers: 1050, 1061, 1082 and 281707 pence for the demo cases. Inside it works in pounds with two decimal places and converts back at the end. Balances are taken to be zero or more.
zh: decimal.Decimal 按十进制存数，所以 Decimal("0.1") + Decimal("0.2") 恰好是 0.3，与 Decimal("0.3") 比较相等。
Decimal 从字符串或整数构造，绝不从浮点数构造。Decimal(0.1) 如实照抄交给它的那个浮点数，而那个浮点数从来就不是十分之一：打印出来是 0.1000000000000000055511151231257827021181583404541015625。Decimal 还没见到这个数，损害就已经造成了。
quantize 按交给它的那个 Decimal 的样子舍入。PENNY 是 0.01，所以每个月的利息都舍到两位小数，rounding 关键字写明用哪条规则。不写就是默认的「半数舍到偶数」，也正是 Python 的 round() 的做法：round(50.5) 是 50，round(51.5) 是 52；而把 50.5 按半数进位 quantize 得 51。
add_interest 收、交的都是便士——实参和结果类型与「钱用整数便士存」相同，答案也相同：演示的几种情形是 1050、1061、1082、281707 便士。内部以英镑、两位小数计算，最后再换回便士。余额约定不为负。

lineNotes.en: interest already has exactly two decimal places, so pounds keeps exactly two as well.
lineNotes.zh: interest 已经恰好两位小数，所以 pounds 也一直恰好两位。

blurb.en: Book and Member hold the facts, Library applies the rules: a loan limit, no borrowing a book that is out, and a fine per day late.
blurb.zh: Book 与 Member 只存事实，Library 执行规则：借阅上限、借出的书不能再借、逾期按天罚款。

en: Three classes, three jobs. Book and Member only hold facts: who has this book and when it is due; which titles this member holds. Library is the only class that knows the rules, and every rule lives in one of its two methods, borrow and give_back. When a rule changes - a higher loan limit, a different fine - there is exactly one place to change it.

lookup does the finding for both methods and raises LoanError for a name or title it does not know, so borrow and give_back start from real objects. Every refusal raises LoanError with its own words and changes nothing, because all the checks come before the first assignment.

Days are plain whole numbers - day 1, day 20 - so the due day is the borrowing day plus 14, and a return is late by its day minus the due day. Taking the larger of 0 and that difference makes an early or on-time return cost nothing instead of a negative fine.

In the demo Ada borrows Dune on day 1 (due on day 15) and Emma on day 3 (due on day 17); Ben cannot have Dune because it is on loan, and Ada's third book is refused at the limit of 2. Ben cannot return Emma because Ada has it. Ada returns Emma on day 10 and pays nothing, then returns Dune on day 20, five days late, and pays 100 pence. Cal is not a member.

give_back compares book.borrower with member using is not: the question is whether it is the very same Member object. run_ops takes operations such as ("borrow", "Ada", "Dune", 1) and ("return", "Ada", "Dune", 20) and returns each result - a due day, a fine, or the words of the refusal.
zh: 三个类，三份差事。Book 与 Member 只存事实：这本书在谁手上、哪天到期；这位成员手上有哪些书。Library 是唯一懂规则的类，每条规则都在它的两个方法 borrow 与 give_back 里。规则一改——上限调高、罚金换算法——要改的地方只有一处。
lookup 替两个方法做查找，不认识的名字或书名就抛 LoanError，于是 borrow 与 give_back 一开始拿到的就是真实的对象。每种拒绝都用自己的话抛 LoanError，而且什么都不改：所有检查都在第一次赋值之前。
日子就是整数——第 1 天、第 20 天——所以应还日是借出那天加 14，逾期天数是还书那天减应还日。取 0 与这个差中大的那个，提前或按时还书就不罚钱，而不是罚一个负数。
演示块里 Ada 第 1 天借 Dune（第 15 天到期）、第 3 天借 Emma（第 17 天到期）；Ben 借不到 Dune，因为它已借出；Ada 的第三本书撞上 2 本的上限被拒。Ben 还不了 Emma，因为书在 Ada 手上。Ada 第 10 天还 Emma，不罚钱；第 20 天还 Dune，逾期五天，罚 100 便士。Cal 不是成员。
give_back 用 is not 比较 book.borrower 和 member：问的是「是不是同一个 Member 对象」。run_ops 收 ("borrow", "Ada", "Dune", 1)、("return", "Ada", "Dune", 20) 这样的操作，返回每一步的结果——应还日、罚金，或者拒绝的那句话。

lineNotes.en: Returned early or on time, day - book.due is zero or negative, and max turns it into 0.
lineNotes.zh: 提前或按时还，day - book.due 是零或负数，max 把它变成 0。

lineNotes.at: action = library.borrow if op[0] == "borrow" else library.give_back
lineNotes.en: Picks the method without calling it; the call comes on the next lines, with the same three arguments either way.
lineNotes.zh: 只挑方法、不调用；调用在后面几行，两个方法收的都是同样三个实参。

blurb.en: The classic exam shape: a while True menu, a checked choice, a dictionary from option to function, and a quit option that breaks out.
blurb.zh: 经典考卷结构：while True 菜单、校验过的选择、从选项到函数的字典，以及跳出循环的退出选项。

en: This is the shape of many exam programs: a while True loop that shows a menu, reads a choice, carries it out, and comes round again until the quit option breaks out of the loop.

Choices are dispatched through ACTIONS, a dictionary from option to function. Adding an option means writing one function and one dictionary entry - no new elif. The functions are stored in the dictionary, not called: there are no brackets after their names there. The call happens later, once the choice is known. Looking up an option that is not in the dictionary gives None, and the loop says so and continues.

Every input is treated as untrusted text. The menu choice is stripped of surrounding spaces and compared as a string, so a letter or a 9 just gets the please-choose message. The task number is tested with isdecimal before int() is called on it, and checked against the length of the list, so removing can never crash. Asking again until the input is valid is covered in 「Files & Exceptions」.

The input is fed in, so the run is always the same: list (no tasks yet), add Revise loops, add Past paper Q3, list both, try to remove task 7 (no such task), remove task 1, choose 9 (not an option), list again - only Past paper Q3 is left - and quit. The prompts Choice:, Task: and Number to remove: stay on the same line as what comes after them, because input() prints its prompt without a newline.
zh: 这是许多考卷程序的结构：一个 while True 循环，显示菜单、读入选择、执行，再绕回来，直到退出选项用 break 跳出循环。
选择经由 ACTIONS 分派，这是一个从选项到函数的字典。加一个选项就是写一个函数、加一个字典条目——不用再加 elif。字典里存的是函数本身，不是调用：那里的函数名后面没有括号。调用发生在后面，等选择确定了才调。查一个不在字典里的选项得到 None，循环说一声、接着转。
每一个输入都当作不可信的文字。菜单选择先去掉两端空白、按字符串比较，所以输入字母或 9 只会得到「请选择」的提示。任务编号先用 isdecimal 查过、才交给 int()，再和列表长度比，所以删除永远不会崩。「输入不合法就一直问」见「文件与异常」。
输入是喂进去的，所以每次运行都一样：列出（还没有任务），添加 Revise loops，添加 Past paper Q3，列出两项，删第 7 项（没有这一项），删第 1 项，选 9（不是选项），再列一次——只剩 Past paper Q3——然后退出。提示语 Choice:、Task:、Number to remove: 和后面的内容在同一行，因为 input() 打印提示语时不换行。

lineNotes.en: Values are the functions themselves - no brackets, so nothing is called here.
lineNotes.zh: 值是函数本身——没有括号，所以这里什么都没调用。

lineNotes.en: The only way out of the while True loop.
lineNotes.zh: 跳出 while True 循环的唯一出口。

title.en: Normal, Boundary and Erroneous Test Data
title.zh: 正常、边界、错误三类测试数据

blurb.en: A table of test data for an age validator - normal, boundary and erroneous - that catches an off-by-one bug the normal cases miss.
blurb.zh: 给年龄校验函数写一张测试数据表——正常、边界、错误三类——它抓得住正常数据漏掉的差一错误。

en: Test data comes in three kinds. Normal data is typical valid input: 17, 64. Boundary data sits at the edges of the valid range, on both sides: 0 and 120 must be accepted, -1 and 121 rejected. Erroneous data is the wrong kind of input altogether: abc, 12.5, an empty string. Boundary tests are the ones that catch off-by-one mistakes, and that is where mistakes gather. CIE 9618 papers use a different set of words: normal, abnormal, extreme and boundary. They roughly match the three kinds here but do not divide things up in quite the same way, so go by the definitions in your own specification.

buggy_is_valid_age is kept on purpose as a first attempt: it compares with < where <= was needed. The normal tests cannot see the mistake - 17 and 64 pass either way - and only the boundary test for 120 fails, so the buggy version passes 8 of the 9 tests. is_valid_age has the comparison right and passes all 9. The final function is the one to use; the buggy one is there only so the test table has something to catch.

Each row is checked with assert, which raises AssertionError when its condition is false. run_tests catches that, prints its own line naming the kind of data, the input and the answer it should have given, and carries on, so one failure does not hide the rest. Python skips assert statements entirely when run with the -O option, so real input checking must never rely on assert; here it is only the test harness.

isdecimal accepts only characters that int() can turn into a number, so a minus sign, a decimal point, a space or an empty string all fail before int() is ever called. A leading zero is still digits: 007 is accepted as 7, while " 17" with a space in front is rejected.
zh: 测试数据分三类。正常数据是典型的合法输入：17、64。边界数据落在合法范围的边沿、两侧都要有：0 和 120 必须接受，-1 和 121 必须拒绝。错误数据是根本不对路的输入：abc、12.5、空串。能抓住差一错误的是边界测试，而错误恰恰爱扎堆在那里。CIE 9618 的考卷用另一套词：normal、abnormal、extreme、boundary——与这里的三类大体对应，但划分不完全一样，以你自己考纲里的定义为准。
buggy_is_valid_age 是故意留下的第一版：该用 <= 的地方写成了 <。正常数据看不出这个错——17 和 64 两种写法都通过——只有 120 那条边界测试失败，所以错的那版 9 条过了 8 条。is_valid_age 把比较写对了，9 条全过。真正要用的是后者；错的那版留着，只是为了让测试表有东西可抓。
每一行用 assert 检查，条件为假时抛 AssertionError。run_tests 接住它，打印自己的一行话——哪类数据、什么输入、本该得到什么——然后接着测，一条失败不会盖住其余的。用 -O 选项运行时 Python 会整个跳过 assert 语句，所以真正的输入校验绝不能靠 assert；这里它只是测试的架子。
isdecimal 只认 int() 能变成数的字符，所以负号、小数点、空格、空串都在调用 int() 之前就被挡下。前导零仍然是数字：007 被接受为 7，而前面带空格的 " 17" 被拒绝。

lineNotes.en: The deliberate bug: < leaves out 120 itself. The tests below catch it.
lineNotes.zh: 故意留的错：< 把 120 本身排除了。下面的测试会抓住它。

lineNotes.en: Catching it here keeps the loop going after a failed row.
lineNotes.zh: 在这里接住，某一行失败之后循环还能接着走。
